bullets.title: NVDA: Jensen Huang Resigns as CEO; Mass Downgrades, PT Cuts Across Wall Street
bullets.body: Jensen Huang resigned as NVIDIA's President, CEO, and board member, effective immediately, amid reports of an extramarital affair with an alleged Chinese intelligence asset (Alice Huang/Megaspeed) that facilitated $7.5B+ in chip shipments to China. CFO Colette Kress named interim CEO while the board engages an outside search firm. The week saw 7+ sell-side downgrades: HSBC hold/PT $170 (from $365), Evercore in line/PT $186 (from $465), Melius hold/PT $185 (from $315), Bernstein market perform/PT $200, Baird neutral/PT $200, Oppenheimer Perform (PT removed), KeyBanc Sector Weight, Craig-Hallum hold/PT $189. Goldman cut PT to $220 (from $300); Morgan Stanley cut to $267 (10% China haircut); DA Davidson cut to $200. Bulls note stock trades ~10x CY27 EPS ($15.60), retail bought $111M in first 30 minutes Thursday (9 std dev move), and GS notes tech allocation at 1st percentile. Upcoming Q3 earnings Nov 17 with consensus ~$109B revenue, $2.47 EPS.

bullets.title: NVDA: Export Control Escalation, DOJ Probe, Congressional Scrutiny
bullets.body: DOJ is pursuing antitrust and criminal probes into NVDA and Supermicro (SMCI) related to Megaspeed chip smuggling to China; NVDA general counsel's outreach to Commerce Dept during the probe transferred the case to DOJ. Congress advancing AI OVERWATCH Act, Chip Security Act, Remote Access Security Act, and MATCH Act in the NDAA. Commerce is finalizing rules blocking Chinese firms' remote access to advanced chips across 7 additional countries. Jensen's resignation materially raises odds of these passing per Wolfe DC Policy.

bullets.title: CSCO: Big Beat-and-Raise; AI Revenue Target Lifted to $9B for FY27
bullets.body: Cisco reported FQ1 revenue $18.52B (+2.2% beat), EPS $1.40 vs $1.33 consensus. FY27 revenue guidance raised to $74.8-75.8B (+$2.5B); AI hyperscale revenue target raised to $9B (>100% YoY growth, 12% of total). Operating margin guided 36% vs prior 35%. Product orders +21% YoY; campus orders +14%. Security ex-Splunk +15% YoY; firewall +30%+ for 3rd quarter. Gross margin under pressure in 2H from hardware mix. KeyBanc OW, PT $135; Morgan Stanley EW, PT $120; Citi Buy, PT cut to $120 from $139. Stock -2.6% on day on order deceleration concerns.

bullets.title: NBIS: Q3 Massive Beat; FY27 Revenue $12-13B, Capex $40-45B; Vineland Delays
bullets.body: Nebius Q3 revenue $980.8M vs $907.2M consensus; adj. EBITDA $465.8M vs $351.8M (47.5% margin). ARR $6.4B vs $4.7B estimated. GPU pricing up >20% QoQ; ACV/MW exceeded $25M vs $20M in Q2. Customer prepayments now cover >100% of associated capex. FY26 revenue guided to low end ($3.0-3.2B) due to Vineland NJ power transition delays. FY27 guidance: $12-13B revenue, $40-45B capex, pre-tax breakeven by end-2027. Citi raises PT to $265 (Buy); Citizens $270, Rosenblatt $304 (Buys); MS $144 EW on delays. Stock -1.9% pre-market Friday.

bullets.title: CRWV: Q3 Beat-and-Raise; Self-Funding Path Clears Key Bear Case
bullets.body: CoreWeave Q3 revenue $3.66B (+168% YoY, ~3% beat); non-GAAP operating margin 10.4% vs 6.9% consensus. FY26 revenue guidance raised to $13.0-13.3B; exit ARR $20-21B. ~$9B in customer prepayments expected over next 3 months; <$5B parent-level equity needed through 2027; no unsecured debt planned. GPU pricing up 25%+ in July with further increases; short-term contracts >$40M/MW, long-term 4-5yr at $20-25M. Stock +14-25% post-earnings. JPM OW, PT $125; Citi Buy, PT raised to $149; Mizuho Neutral, PT cut to $68.

bullets.title: FOXA: Morgan Stanley Names Top Pick Post-Roku Deal Close; $90 PT (37% Upside)
bullets.body: Morgan Stanley resumed Overweight and elevated FOXA to Top Pick following the early close of the $22B Roku acquisition. Pro forma revenue growth lifts to ~6% (from low-single digits); EBITDA CAGR rises to ~9% from ~1% (CY27-30E); FCF/share compounds at ~20% through FY30. $400M+ cost synergies modeled; $500M-1B revenue synergy excluded from base case. Fox/Tubi/Roku Channel combined hold 10%+ monthly US TV viewing. Net leverage falls from 2.8x at close to ~1x by FY29. Bull case $100, bear case $60. Seaport also upgraded to Buy, PT $76.

bullets.title: HUBS: Co-Founder Halligan Returns as CEO; CFO from Adobe; Guidance Reaffirmed
bullets.body: Brian Halligan returns as CEO effective November 12, replacing Yamini Rangan, who stays through Dec 1. CFO Kate Bueker retiring Feb 11, 2027; Adobe's Karen Burgess joins as EVP Finance Nov 30 and CFO Feb 11. Company reaffirmed Q4/FY26 guidance. Halligan described the transition as a 're-founding' around product, culture, and go-to-market. JPM and Mizuho both constructive; KeyBanc Sector Weight. Stock +7-10% on announcement.

bullets.title: RBLX: Downgraded to Neutral at Citi; GTA VI Launch Risk, Bookings Below Guidance
bullets.body: Citi downgraded RBLX from Buy to Neutral, maintaining $55 PT. Steal An Egg CCU down ~56% from September peak with no breakout hit emerging. November MTD CCUs suggest 4Q26 bookings of ~$1.92B, slightly below guidance midpoint of $1.95B. GTA VI launching November 19 poses engagement risk. Management noted limited data to size impact.

bullets.title: IONQ: Gains Commvault CFO Gary Merrill as New CFO
bullets.body: IonQ named Gary Merrill as CFO effective early December; Merrill is currently CFO of Commvault Systems. Inder Singh steps down immediately from IonQ. KeyBanc flagged CVLT's CFO departure negatively given Merrill's influence on GTM organization. CVLT reaffirmed FY27 guidance; KeyBanc maintains CVLT at $200 PT.

bullets.title: TLN: Oppenheimer Initiates OUTPERFORM, $400 PT; 750 MW Long-Term Capacity Deal
bullets.body: TLN signed a 750 MW, 7-year PJM capacity agreement for delivery years 2029/2030-2035/2036 generating ~$100M/year in revenue. Oppenheimer initiated at Outperform, $400 PT. Base FCF/share guidance: ~$38/$48/$46-50 for 2027/2028/2029E (~30% CAGR). Company executing $1.5B ASR. Wells Fargo sees the deal advancing the strategy to convert PJM capacity fundamentals into contracted cash flows. Goldman raised PT to $502.

bullets.title: SNDK: 8-for-1 Stock Split Confirmed, Ex-Date November 20
bullets.body: SanDisk executing an 8-for-1 stock split with ex-date November 20, 2026; record date November 9; payable November 19; allocation November 21. Fractions to be paid in cash in lieu.

bullets.title: INTU: JPM Maintains Neutral Ahead of F1Q27; Derisked but Unsustainable Without Funnel Improvement
bullets.body: JPM forecasts F1Q27 revenue $4.297B (+11% YoY), slightly below guidance midpoint. Management sacrificing near-term ARPC growth to drive customer acquisition via entry-level products. New customer adds in QuickBooks and TurboTax DIY remain weak. Credit Karma launched $0 Federal/$15 State filing offer. JPM expects shares to stay range-bound without revenue/customer growth inflection. FY27 total revenue forecast $23.383B (+9% YoY), below guidance midpoint. Stock trades at 10x uFCF.

bullets.title: AAPL: 52-Week High at $360; iPhone Duo Returns >30%; China Renaissance Upgrades to Buy, $425 PT
bullets.body: Apple hit a 52-week high at $360, up 31.6% YTD. However, comms/IT weekly noted >30% iPhone Duo return rate due to lack of FaceID, camera quality, and durability concerns. Apple's on-device AI also flagged as lagging emerging personal assistants like Muse. China Renaissance upgraded AAPL to Buy from Hold, PT $425 (22% upside vs current $348).

bullets.title: DIS: Evercore Sees Catalysts in Personalization, Avengers Slate, Double-Digit FY27 Growth
bullets.body: Evercore ISI previewed potential catalysts for DIS ahead of Q4 earnings (Nov 17). Key focus areas: Disney+/Hulu app personalization to drive DTC revenue, deep content slate (Avengers: Doomsday), and double-digit FY27 EPS growth with potential FY28 acceleration. DIS also announced a multi-year strategic alliance with Adobe for AI-powered tools in innovation labs.

bullets.title: CHTR: Debt Tender Offer Catalyst; Bonds at ~85% of Par Represent Upside
bullets.body: Charter announced a debt tender offer to repurchase bonds for up to $1.5B cash; bonds trading at substantial discount to $11.6B face value. Citi sees potential $27/sh equity value capture through YE27 via debt discount. Stock up ~12% on the announcement. Q3 pro forma EBITDA fell 4% YoY; residential revenue -4.1% YoY. Management targeting $2B annualized opex savings over 18 months plus Cox synergies.

bullets.title: MDB: BTIG Initiates Buy at $417 PT; 27% Upside
bullets.body: BTIG initiated MongoDB at Buy with a $417 price target, implying ~27% upside from $327.37. Analyst Gray Powell. FactSet consensus target is $458.82.

bullets.title: PINS/META/GOOGL/AMZN: ChatGPT Ads Hit $1B ARR; Pinterest Identified as Clearest Share Donor
bullets.body: Roth survey finds OpenAI's ChatGPT Ads reached ~$1B annualized run rate by August 2026, growing from ~600 to 10,000+ advertisers in 7 months. Only 11% of agencies buying ChatGPT ads currently; ROI perceived as middling, in line with Pinterest/Nextdoor, below Google/Instagram/TikTok. Pinterest identified as the clearest share donor, with more agencies planning to cut vs. add spend there in 2026-2027.

bullets.title: GLW: Jefferies Initiates Buy at $134 PT on AI Fiber Demand
bullets.body: Jefferies initiated Corning at Buy with $134 PT (20% upside from $112.13), citing fiber demand running ahead of supply and $18B+ hyperscaler agreements. Analyst Dushyant Ailani. GLW is viewed as one of the clearest AI infrastructure beneficiaries with photonics as the next major opportunity.

bullets.title: AFRM: Mizuho Reaffirms Outperform, $100 PT; GMV on Track for $10 EPS by 2030 But RLTC Still Needs Proof
bullets.body: AFRM F1Q27 GMV grew 34% to $14.4B; card GMV +117% YoY; active cardholders 6.0M. RLTC at 4.30% of GMV beat guidance but credit loss provision rose. Mizuho reaffirms Outperform, $100 PT. Active consumer growth slowed to 19%; card spend per cardholder at ~$2.2K annualized vs $4.95K needed. RLTC needs to reach 5.4% to deliver ~$3 EPS toward $10 2030 target.
